verses: Logo! apney perwerdigar say daro! bila-shuba qayamat ka zalzalay boht hi bari cheez hai

Jiss din tum ussay dekh lo gay her doodh pilaney wali apney doodh peetay bachay ko bhool jaye gi aur tamam hamal waliyon kay hamal gir jayen gay aur to dekhay ga kay log madhosh dikhaee den gay, halankay dar-haqeeqat woh matwalay na hun gay lekin Allah ka azab bara hi sakht hai
Baaz log Allah kay baray mein baaten banatay hain aur woh bhi bey ilmi kay sath aur her sirkash shetan ki pairwee kertay hain
Jiss per (qaza-e elahi) likh di gaee hai kay jo koi uss ki rafaqat keray ga woh ussay gumrah ker dey ga aur ussay aag kay azab ki taraf ley jaye ga

Logo! agar tumhen marney kay baad ji uthney mein shak hai to socho hum ney tumhen mitti say peda kiya phir nutfay say phir khoon basta say phir gosht kay lothray say jo soorat diya gaya tha aur bey naqsha tha. Yeh hum tum per zahir ker detay hain, aur hum jissay chahayen aik thehraye huye waqt tak reham reham-e-madir mein rakhtay hain phir tumhen bachpan ki halat mein duniya mein latay hain phir takay tum apni poori jawani ko phoncho, tum mein say baaz to woh hain jo fot ker liye jatay hain aur baaz bey gharz umar ki taraf phir say lota diye jatay hain kay woh aik cheez say ba-khabar honey kay baad phir bey khabar ho jaye. To dekhta hai kay zamin (banjar aur) khushk hai phir hum uss per barishen barsatay hain to woh ubharti hai aur phoolti hai aur her qasam ki ronaq daar nabataat ugati hai
Yeh uss liye kay Allah hi haq hai aur o hi mardon ko jilata hai aur woh her her cheez per qudrat rakhney wala hai
Aur yeh kay qayamat qata’an aaney wali hai jiss mein koi shak o shuba)yeh nahi aur yaqeenan Allah Taalaa qabron walon ko doobara zindah farmaye ga
Baaz log Allah kay baray mein baghair ilm kay aur baghair hidayat kay aur baghair roshan kitab kay jhagartay hain
Jo apni pehloo morney wala bann ker uss liye kay Allah ki raah say behka, ussay duniya mein bhi ruswaee hogi aur qayamat kay din bhi hum ussay jahannum mein jalney ka azab chakhayen gay
Yeh unn aemaal ki wajah say jo teray hathon ney aagay bhej rakhay thay. Yaqeen mano kay Allah Taalaa apney bandon per zulm kerney wala nahi

Baaz log aisay bhi hain kay aik kinaray per (kharay) ho ker Allah ki ibadat kertay hain. Agar koi nafa mill gaya to dilchaspi lenay lagtay hain aur agar koi aafat aagaee to ussi waqt mun pher letay hain, unhon ney dono jahaan nuksan utha liya. Waqaee yeh khulla nuksan hai
Allah kay siwa unhen pukartay hain jo na unhen nuksan phoncha saken na nafa. Yehi to door daraz ki gumrahi hai
Ussay pukartay hain jiss ka nuksan uss kay nafa say ziyadah qareeb hai, yaqeenan buray wali hain aur buray sathi
Eman aur nek aemaal walon ko Allah Taalaa lehren leti hui nehron wali jannaton mein ley jaye ga. Allah jo iradah keray ussay ker kay rehta hai

Jiss ka yeh khayal ho kay Allah Taalaa apney rasool ki madad dono jahaan mein na keray ga woh unchaee per aik rassa bandh ker (apney halaq mein phanda daal ker apna gala ghoont ley) phir dekh ley kay uss ki chalakkiyon say woh baat hatt jati hai jo ussay tarpa rahi hai?
Hum ney ussi tarah uss Quran ko wazeh aayaton mein utara hai jissay Allah chahaye hidayat naseeb farmata hai
Be-shak ahl eman aur yahudi aur saabi aur nasrani aur majoosi aur mushrikeen unn sab kay darmiyan qayamat kay din khud Allah Taalaa faislay ker dey ga, Allah Taalaa her her cheez per gawah hai

Kiya to nahi dekh raha kay Allah kay samney sajdah mein hain sab aasmano walay aur sab zaminon walay aur sooraj aur chand aur sitaray aur pahar aur darakht aur janwar aur boht say insan bhi. Haan boht say woh bhi hain jin per azab ka maqoola sabit ho chuka hai, jissay rab zaleel kerdey ussay koi izzat denay wala nahi, Allah jo chahata hai kerta hai
Yeh dono apney rab kay baray mein ikhtilaf kerney walay hain, pus kafiron kay liye to aag kay kapray beywant ker kaatay jayen gay, aur unn kay saron kay upper say sakht kholta hua pani bahaya jaye ga
Jiss say unn kay pet ki sab cheezen aur khaalen gala di jayen gi
Aur unn ki saza kay liye lohay kay hathoray hain
Yeh jab bhi o haan kay ghum say nikal bhagney ka iradah keren gay o hain lota diye jayen gay aur (kaha jaye ga) jalney ka azab chakho

Eman walon aur nek kaam walon ko Allah Taalaa unn jannaton mein ley jaye ga jin kay darakhton talay say nehren lehren ley rahi hain, jahan woh soney kay kanggan pehnaye jayen gay aur sachay moti bhi. O haan unn ka libas khalis resham hoga
Unn ko pakeezah baat ki rehnumaee ker di gaee aur qabil sad tareef raah ki hidayat ker di gaee

Jin logon ney kufur kiya aur Allah ki raah say rokney lagay aur uss hurmat wali masjid say bhi jissay hum ney tamam logon kay liye masawi ker diya hai o hain kay rehney walay hun ya bahir kay hun, jo bhi zulm kay sath o haan ilhaad ka iradah keray hum ussay dard naak azab chakhayen gay

Aur jabkay hum ney Ibrahim (alaihi as-salam) ko kaaba kay makan ki jagah muqarrar ker di uss shart per kay meray sath kissi ko shareek na kerna aur meray ghar ko tawaf qayam rukoo sajdah kerney walon kay liye pak saaf rakhna
Aur logon mein hajj ki munadi ker dey log teray pass paa piyada bhi aayen gay aur dublay patley oonton per bhi aur door daraz ki tamam raahon say aayen gay
Apney faeeday hasil kerney ko aajayen aur unn muqarrara dino mein Allah ka naam yaad keren aur chopayon per jo paltoo hain. Pus tum aap bhi khao aur bhookay faqeeron ko bhi khilao
Phir woh apna mail kuchail door keren aur apni nazren poori keren aur Allah kay qadeem ghar ka tawaf keren

Yeh hai aur jo koi Allah ki hurmaton ki tazeem keray uss kay apney liye uss kay rab kay pass behtri hai. Aur tumharay liye chopaye janwar halal ker diye gaye ba-juz unn kay jo tumharay samney biyan kiye gaye hain pus tumhen buton ki gandagi say bachtay rehna chahaiye aur jhooti baat say bhi perhez kerna chahaiye

Allah ki toheed ko mantay huye uss kay sath kissi ko shareek na kertay huye. Suno! Allah kay sath shareek kerney wala goya aasman say gir para, abb ya to ussay parinday uchak ley jayen gay ya hua kissi door daraz ki jagah phenk dey gi
Yeh sunn liya abb aur suno! Allah ki nishaniyon ki jo izzat o hurmat keray uss kay dil ki perhez gaari ki wajah say yeh hai
Unn mein tumharay liye aik muqarrar waqt tak faeedah hai phir unn kay halal honey ki jagah khana kaaba hai

Aur her ummat kay liye hum ney qurbani kay tareeqay muqarrar farmaye hain takay woh unn chopaye janwaron per Allah ka naam len jo Allah ney unhen dey rakhay hain. Samajh lo kay tum sab ka mabood bar-haq sirf aik hi hai tum ussi kay tabey farman ho jao aajzi kerney walon ko khushkhabri suna dijiye

Unhen kay jab Allah ka zikar kiya jaye unn kay dil tharra jatay hain. Unhen jo buraee phonchay uss per sabar kertay hain, namaz qaeem kerney walay hain aur jo kuch hum ney unhen dey rakha hai woh uss mein say bhi detay rehtay hain

Qurbani kay oont hum ney tumharay liye Allah Taalaa ki nishaniyan muqarrar ker di hain unn mein tumhen nafa hai. Pus unhen khara ker kay unn per Allah ka naam lo, phir jab unn kay pehloo zamin say lag jayen ussay (khud bhi) khao aur miskeen sawal say rukney walon aur sawal kerney walon ko bhi khilao, ussi tarah hum ney chopayon ko tumharay ma-tehat kerdiya hai kay tum shukar guzari kero

Allah Taalaa ko qurbaniyon kay gosht nahi phonchtay na uss kay khoon balkay)yeh ussay to tumharay dil ki perhezgari phonchti hai. Ussi tarah Allah ney unn janwaron ko tumharay mutee ker diya hai kay tum uss ki rehnumaee kay shuriye mein uss ki baraiyan biyan kero, aur nek logon ko khushkhabri suna dijiye
Sunn rakho! yaqeenan sachay mominon kay dushmanon ko khud Allah Taalaa hata deta hai. Koi khayanat kerney wala nashukra Allah Taalaa ko hergiz pasand nahi
Jin (musalmanon) say (kafir) jang ker rahey hain unhen bhi muqablay ki ijazat di jati hai kyunkay woh mazloom hain. Be-shak unn ki madad per Allah qadir hai

Yeh woh hain jinhen na-haq apney gharon say nikala gaya, sirf unn kay uss qol per kay humara perwerdigar faqat Allah hai. Agar Allah Taalaa logon ko aapas mein aik doosray say na hatata rehta to ibadat khaney aur girjay aur masjiden aur yahudiyon kay maabad aur woh masjiden bhi dha di jatin jahan Allah ka naam ba kasrat liya jata hai. Jo Allah ki madad keray ga Allah bhi zaroor uss ki madad keray ga. Be-shak Allah Taalaa bari qooaton wala baray ghalbay wala hai

Yeh woh log hain kay agar hum zamin mein unn kay paon jama den to yeh poori pabandi say namazen qaeem keren aur zakaten den aur achay kaamon ka hukum keren aur buray kaamon say mana keren. Tamam kaamon ka anjam Allah kay ikhtiyar mein hai
Agar yeh log aap ko jhutlayen (to koi tajjub ki baat nahi) to unn say pehlay Nooh ki qom aur aad aur samood
Aur qom Ibrahim aur qom Loot

Aur madiyan walay bhi apney apney nabiyon ko jhutla chukay hain. Musa (alaihi as-salam) bhi jhutlaye jaa chukay hain pus mein ney kafiron ko yun hi si mohlat di phir dhar dabaya, phir mera azab kaisa hua?

Boht si bastiyan hain jinhen hum ney teh bala ker diya uss liye kay woh zalim thay pus woh apni chaton kay bal ondhi hui pari hain aur boht say abad koowen beykaar paray hain aur boht say pakkay aur buland mehal weeran paray hain

Kiya unhon ney zamin mein sair sair-o-sayyaahat nahi ki jo unn kay dil unn baaton kay samajhney walay hotay ya kanon say hi unn (waqiyaat) ko sunn letay, baat yeh hai kay sirf aankhen hi andhi nahi hotin balkay)yeh woh dil andhay ho jatay hain jo seenon mein hain
Allah hergiz apna wada nahi taalay ga. Haan albatta aap kay rab kay nazdeek aik din tumhari ginti kay aitbaar say aik hazar saal ka hai
Boht si zulm kerney wali bastiyon ko mein ney dheel di phir aakhir unhen pakar liya, aur meri hi taraf lot ker aana hai
Ailaan ker do kay logo! mein tumhen khullam khulla chokanna kerney wala hi hun
Pus jo eman laye hain aur jinhon ney nek amal kiye hain unn hi kay liye bakhsish hai aur izzat wali rozi
Aur jo log humari nishaniyon ko pust kerney kay darpay rehtay hain o hi dozakhi hain

Hum ney aap say pehlay jiss rasool aur nabi ko bheja uss kay sath yeh hua kay jab woh apney dil mein koi aarzoo kerney laga shetan ney uss ki aarzoo mein kuch mila diya, pus shetan ki milawat ko Allah Taalaa door ker deta hai phir apni baaten pakki ker deta hai. Allah Taalaa dana aur ba-hikmat hai
Yeh uss liye kay shetani milawat ko Allah Taalaa unn logon ki aazmaeesh ka zariye bana dey jin kay dilon mein beemari hai aur jin kay dil sakht hain. Be-shak zalim log gehri mukhalifat mein hain

Aur uss liye bhi kay jinhen ilm ata farmaya gaya hai woh yaqeen ker len kay yeh aap kay rab hi ki taraf say sirasir haq hi hai phir woh uss per eman layen aur unn kay dil uss ki taraf jhuk jayen. Yaqeenan Allah Taalaa eman daron ko raah raast ki taraf rehbari kerney wala hi hai
Kafir uss wahee elahi mein hamesha shak shuba)yeh hi kertay rahen gay hatta kay achanak unn kay saron per qayamat aajaye ya unn kay pass uss din ka azab aajaye jo manhoos hai
Uss din sirf Allah hi ki badshahat hogi o hi unn mein faislay farmaye ga. Eman aur nek amal walay to nematon say bhari jannaton mein hun gay
Aur jin logon ney kufur kiya aur humari aayaton ko jhutlaya unn kay liye zaleel kerney walay azab hain

Aur jin logon ney raah khuda mein tarak watan kiya phir woh shaheed ker diye gaye ya apni maut marr gaye Allah Taalaa unhen behtareen rizq ata farmaye ga. Aur be-shak Allah Taalaa rozi denay walon mein sab say behtar hai
Unhen Allah Taalaa aisi jagah phonchaye ga kay woh uss say razi ho jayen gay, be-shak Allah Taalaa ilm aur burdbari wala hai

Baat yehi hai, aur jiss ney badla liya ussi kay barabar jo uss kay sath kiya gaya tha phir agar uss say ziyadti ki jaye to yaqeenan Allah Taalaa khud uss ki madad farmaye ga. Be-shak Allah darguzar kerney wala bakhshney wala hai
Yeh uss liye kay Allah raat ko din mein dakhil kerta hai aur din ko raat mein dakhil kerta hai, aur be-shak Allah sunnay wala dekhney wala hai
Yeh sab uss liye kay Allah hi haq hai aur uss kay siwa jissay bhi yeh pukartay hain woh baatil hai aur be-shak Allah hi bulandi wala kibriyaee wala hai
Kiya aap ney nahi dekha kay Allah Taalaa aasman say pani barsata hai, pus zamin sirsabz ho jati hai. Bey shak Allah Taalaa meharban aur ba-khabar hai
Aasmano aur zamin mein jo kuch hai ussi ka hai aur yaqeenan Allah o hi hai bey niaz tareefon wala

Kiya aap ney nahi dekha kay Allah hi ney zamin ki tamam cheezen tumharay liye musakhar ker di hain aur uss kay farman say pani mein chalti hui kashtiyan bhi. O hi aasman ko thamay huye hai kay zamin per uss ki ijazat kay baghair na gir paray, be-shak Allah Taalaa logon per shafqat o narmi kerney wala aur meharban hai
Ussi ney tumhen zindagi bakhshi, phir o hi tumhen maar dalay ga phir o hi tumhen zindah keray ga, bey shak insan albatta nashukra hai

Her ummat kay liye hum ney ibadat ka aik tareeqa muqarrar ker diya hai, jissay woh baja laney walay hain pus unhen uss amar mein aap say jhagra na kerna chahaiye aap apney perwerdigar ki taraf logon ko buliye. Yaqeenan aap theek hidayat per hi hain
Phir bhi agar yeh log aap say ulajhney lagen to aap keh den kay tumharay aemaal say Allah bakhoobi waqif hai
Be-shak tumharay sab kay ikhtilaf ka faisla qayamat walay din Allah Taalaa aap keray ga
Kiya aap ney nahi jana kay aasman o zamin ki her cheez Allah kay ilm mein hai. Yeh sab likhi hui kitab mein mehfooz hai. Allah Taalaa per to yeh amar bilkul aasan hai
Aur yeh Allah kay siwa unn ki ibadat ker rahey hain jiss ki koi khudaee daleel nazil nahi hui na woh khud hi uss ka koi ilm rakhtay hain. Zalimon ka koi madadgar nahi

Jab unn kay samney humaray kalaam ki khulli hui aayaton ki tilawat ki jati hai to aap kafiron kay chehron per khushi kay saaf aasaar pehchan letay hain. Woh to qareeb hotay hain kay humari aayaten sunaney walon per hamla ker bethen, keh dijiye kay kiya mein tumhen uss say bhi ziyadah badtar khabar doon. Woh aag hai, jiss ka wada Allah ney kafiron say ker rakha hai, aur woh boht hi buri jagah hai

Logo! aik misal biyan ki jaa rahi hai, zara kaan laga ker sunn lo! Allah kay siwa jin jin ko tum pukartay rahey ho woh aik makhi bhi to peda nahi ker saktay, go saray kay saray hi jama ho jayen, balkay)yeh agar makhi unn say koi cheez ley bhagay to yeh to ussay bhi uss say cheen nahi saktay, bara boda hai talab kerney wala aur bara boda hai woh jiss say talab kiya jaa raha hai
Unhon ney Allah kay martaba kay mutabiq uss ki qadar jaani hi nahi, Allah Taalaa bara hi zor o qooat wala aur ghalib o zabardast hai
Farishton mein say aur insano mein say paygham phonchney walon ko Allah hi chant leta hai, be-shak Allah Taalaa sunnay wala dekhney wala hai
Woh bakhoobi janta hai jo kuch unn kay aagay hai aur jo kuch unn kay peechay hai, aur Allah hi ki taraf sab kaam lotaye jatay hain
Aey eman walo! rukoo sajdah kertay raho aur apney perwerdigar ki ibadat mein lagay raho aur nek kaam kertay raho takay tum kaamyaab ho jao

Aur Allah ki raah mein wesa hi jihad kero jaisa jihad ka haq hai. Ussi ney tumhen bargazeedah banaya hai aur tum per deen kay baray mein koi tangi nahi daali, deen apney baap Ibrahim (alaihi as-salam) ka qaeem rakho, ussi Allah ney tumhara naam musalman rakha hai. Uss Quran say pehlay aur uss mein bhi takay payghumbar tum per gawah ho jaye aur tum tamam logon kay gawah bann jao. Pus tumhen chahaiye kay namazen qaeem rakho aur zakat ada kertay raho aur Allah ko mazboot thaam lo, o hi tumhara o li aur malik hai. Pus kiya hi acha malik hai aur kitan hi behtar madadgar hai
